newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp of America Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp of America Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - Q4 1995 shr includes a charge of $15 million to increase the provision for doubtful accounts. Excluding the charge, Q4 1995 oper profit was $8.5 million, or $0.07 per share.

1996 full-year results include Q2 charges of $23 million related to additional restructuring and nonrecurring charges related to a merger and $10 million to increase the allowance for doubtful accounts, and a Q3 charge of $185 million to increase reserves for anticipated government and private claims resulting from the government's investigations related to prior billing practices of certain predecessor companies.
Excluding those charges, 1996 net income was $13.4 million, or $0.11 per share.

In 1995, the company posted charges of $15 million in Q4 to increase the provision for doubtful accounts, $65 million in Q2 for restructuring related to the merger with Roche Biomedical Laboratories Inc, and a $10 million provision for settlements related to various matters, including billing.
Excluding those charges, 1995 net income was $50.9 million, or $0.46 per share.
